definitions: The planet on which we live; the third planet from the sun.
The substance of the land surface; soil or dirt.
The hole used as a dwelling by a burrowing animal, such as a fox.
A connection between an electrical circuit or equipment and the ground.
examples: The Earth rotates on its axis.
He filled the pot with fresh earth.
The fox retreated to its earth.
Connect the green wire to the earth terminal.
